name: Sower
description: The other turn of the Gland's slot: a wasp seen side-on, arcane purple banded in orchid, thin at the waist, with a bone ovipositor trailing back under the abdomen and three of its young — `use: ss.enemy.tick`, the very shot it fires — clinging beneath it. The wings blur over the back as pale washes. It does not aim (EnemyType.shotTurn: what it lets go turns toward the player on its own), so nothing on it points; the read is a body carrying live cargo, and the cargo is the threat. Purple, because nothing else on the pan is, and because the tick is. No `elite` variant: a squad body is never marked. Drawn facing +x, mirrored by the game. Gameplay radius 11. The `death` clip drops the young off the abdomen and folds the wings.

drift.description: six legs walk under a body that bobs on the step, the wings blur over the back, the abdomen rocks on its petiole and the young clinging under it stir

death.description: the wings fold down over the back and go still, the abdomen droops on its petiole with the ovipositor swinging under it, the young drop off and scatter, the head falls and the organ goes out
